answer: A wharf work-slot burn stops fakes: each claims one wharf slot, burning a 45-credit deposit; a mirror ledger lists slots and receipts. Each epoch a beacon draws 5 percent of slots; holders must file a fresh dune survey receipt in one hour or lose the deposit. One receipt per slot; a rented slot still burns its deposit. Keeping 1,000 fakes costs 45,000 burned plus 1,000 receipts each epoch. An honest agent burns 45 once, one receipt per epoch.
